question: im undecided and trying to compare psychology and sociology majors. how many credits does each one need and do they overlap at all?
answer:
The catalog lists Psychology BA and Sociology BA [14]. Both are Bachelor of Arts majors. Their Fall 2026 recommended plans, for students admitted during 2026–2027, each state “Total Credits Required: 128 credits” for the degree [1][2]. The catalog’s general rule says major requirements must total at least 40 and may not exceed 64 credits, but the information here does not give an exact major-only credit total for either major [5]. For that exact breakdown, contact the School of Social Sciences and Social Work Office: SSSWOffice@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7625 or (201) 684-7562 [1][2].

There is some overlap: both major requirement lists include Career Pathways PATH 001 and PATH 003 [1][2]. Psychology lists PATH 001 twice; Sociology also requires PATH 002 [1][2]. If pursuing both majors, no more than half the courses may count toward both, and you must complete all writing-intensive courses required for the second major [4].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-BA-PSYC) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-BA-SOCI) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [14](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: how many credits is the minor in data science
answer:
The Data Science Minor has no exact total stated here. Ramapo says an undergraduate minor must include between 16 and 24 credits, including non-General Education prerequisites and excluding lab science course credits [3].

The Data Science Minor requires all of CMPS 130 SCI PROBLEM SOLVING-PYTHON, CMPS 240 DATA ANALYTICS IN PYTHON, DATA 101 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE, and DATA 301 DATA ANALYSIS & VISUALIZATION, plus one elective from BADM 225 MANAGEMENT STATISTICS; BIOL 354 RESEARCH DESIGN & STATISTICS; MATH 353 STATISTICS; MATH 370 APPLIED STATISTICS; POLI 316 POLITICAL ANALYSIS; PSYC 242 STATISTICS; SOCI 308 DATA ANALYSIS IN SOCIOLOGY; or SWRK 307 SOCIAL WORK RESEARCH METHODS [1]. Data Science 4+1, Data Science BS, and Data Science MS are also published [1].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-MN-DSCI) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1)

question: Is there a nursing major for freshmen or do you have to apply separately after first year? and how long does it take to finish
answer:
Yes. The catalog lists Nursing Generic BSN among the bachelor's majors for “nursing freshmen”; it also lists Nursing Accelerated BSN and Nursing RN to BSN. [17] Nursing Generic BSN is a Bachelor of Science in Nursing; Nursing MSN is also published. [2]

The generic curriculum has students complete general education and science requirements in the first two years; after satisfactory completion, they enter the two-year nursing sequence. The page doesn’t say whether a separate application is required to enter that sequence. Contact the Nursing Programs Office: (201) 684-7749, Adler Center for Nursing Excellence 215.

For students admitted during 2026–2027, the recommended plan is titled “Nursing — Fall 2026.” It lays out four years: first-year fall 17 credits and spring 16; second-year fall (no total stated) and spring 15; third-year fall 16 and spring 16; fourth-year fall 16 and spring 16. Total credits required: 128; GPA required: 2.3. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURG) [17](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: what are the prereqs for cmps 147
answer:
CMPS 147 COMPUTER SCIENCE I (4 credits) has the following prerequisite: complete one of these courses—MATH 021 PREPARATION FOR COLLEGE MATHEMATICS PROGRAM; MATH 022 TRANSITIONAL MATHEMATICS; MATH 024 ELEMENTARY ALGEBRA TOPICS; MATH 100T TRANSFER GE MATH EQUIVALENT; MATH 101 MATH WITH APPLICATIONS; MATH 104 MATH FOR THE MODERN WORLD; MATH 108 ELEMENTARY PROBABILITY AND STATISTICS; MATH 110 PRECALCULUS; or MATH 121 CALCULUS I. Alternatively, complete one placement test with the required minimum score: ACCUPLACER Quantitative Reasoning (258); ACCUPLACER Advanced Algebra and Functions (260); ACT Composite (26); or SAT MATH (580). [1]

question: can you finish a business major in 4 years if you declare in sophmore year
answer:
Yes, it can be possible: the Center for Student Success says to aim to declare during sophomore year if you intend to graduate in four years. It also says most majors require at least two years to complete, and usually have foundation classes that can be taken in your first year. [3] The catalog identifies International Business BA as the bachelor's major for “finish business years.” [2] This is general guidance, not a guarantee for your specific course progress. Declare before completing 64 credits. [5]

For help checking your plan, contact the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising): success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, D-207. [3]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/major/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/declare-major-minor-certificate/)

question: what's the difference between the communication arts major and the journalism minor, like what classes are in each

question: how many gen ed credits do i need total and which categories are there
answer:
The pages don’t state an exact total number of General Education credits required. They say the curriculum “should not exceed 41 credits” [5]. Ramapo students complete ten General Education courses: four keystone courses, one course in each of four keystone categories, and one course in two of three distribution categories [2].

The keystone categories are Global Awareness, Historical Perspectives, Scientific Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning [2]. The distribution categories are Culture and Creativity, Values and Ethics, and Social Systems and Society [3]. Pages 2 and 4 call the third distribution category “Systems, Sustainability, & Society” / “Systems, Sustainability, and Society,” so the pages differ in its name [2][4].

For the exact credits that apply to your degree, contact the Office of the Provost: provost@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7330, first floor of the Birch Mansion [2].

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/curriculum-and-assessment/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/home/comprehensive-academic-plan/resources/) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#general-education) [5](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1)

question: What does the Intro to Biology course cover and how many credits is it? thinking about bio vs chem
answer:
BIOL 101 Introduction to Biology is 4 credits. It examines biology’s development as a science, unifying principles such as genetic/evolutionary theory, how organisms are adapted to their environments, and how biology uses scientific methods to learn about the natural world. Individual sections may focus on topics such as biodiversity or human anatomy and physiology. [4]

I don’t have verified information to compare this course with a chemistry course or recommend which to choose. Contact the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office at SNHOffice@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7734.

Sources: [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/BIOL101)

question: can you check how many credits i have so far and tell me which major im closest to finishing
answer:
I can’t see your personal credit total or degree progress, so I don’t have verified information about how many credits you have or which major you’re closest to finishing. The catalog lists no bachelor’s major for “tell closest finishing” [1].

The Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) explains how to view your degree evaluation, which outlines your major’s class requirements [6]:
1. Visit https://web.ramapo.edu/, click “Web for Students,” then “Web Registration.”
2. Enter the Secure Area with your Ramapo login and password.
3. Click “Student and Financial Aid,” “Student Records,” then “Degree Evaluation.”
4. Select the current term and click enter, then “Generate New Evaluation.”
5. Click the circle next to your major and “Generate Request.”
6. Select detail requirements and click “Submit.” [6]

The Registrar also advises reviewing your degree audit and meeting with your adviser [3]. Contact the Center for Student Success at success@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7441 [6], or the Registrar at reg@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7695 [3].
